m: 1. मुष् cl. 1. P. मोषति v.l. for √ मष्, q.v.

2. मुष् cl. 9. 1. P. (Dhātup. xxxi, 58 and xvii, 25 v.l.; cf. √ 1. मूष्) मुष्णाति, मोषति (ep. also cl. 6. P. मुषति; 2. sg. Imp. मुषाण, Śiś.; pf. मुमोष; aor. अमोषीत्, 2. sg. मोषीस्, RV.; fut. मोषिता, मोषिष्यति Gr.; ind.p. मुषित्वा, Daś.; Kathās.; मुद्ष्य, RV.; inf. मुषे, ib. ; मोषितुम् Gr.), to steal, rob, plunder, carry off (also with two acc. = take away from, deprive of), RV. &c. &c.; to ravish, captivate, enrapture (the eyes or the heart), MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to blind, dazzle (the eyes), ib.; to cloud, obscure (light or the intellect), ib.; to break, destroy, Kāvyād. (cf. √ मुस्) : Pass., मुष्यते (ep. also ˚ति; aor. अमोषि), to be stolen or robbed, MBh.; Kāv. &c.: Caus., मोषयति (aor. अमूमुषत्) Gr.: Desid. मुमुषिषति, ib. (cf. मुनुषिषु) : Intens. मोमुष्यते, मोमोष्टि, ib. [For kindred words, see under 2. मूष्, p. 827.]
3. मुष् mfn. (ifc.; nom. मुट्), stealing, robbing, removing, destroying, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
surpassing, excelling, Megh.; Kād.; Bālar.
मुष् f. stealing, theft, MW.
a: मुष् — {vI.v} {c9c} P. (मुष्णाति, मुषित; desid. मुमुषिषति) 1 (a) To steal, filch, rob, plunder, carry off (said to govern two acc.; देवदत्तं शतं मुष्णाति, but very rarely used in classical literature); मुषाणरत्नानि Śi. 1. 51; 3. 38; क्षत्रस्य मुष्णन् वसु जैत्रमोजः Ki. 3. 41; Śi. 3. 38. (b) To ravish, seduce, ab duct, carry off; Bk. 15. 16 --2 To dispel, remove, drive off; घनतिमिरमुषि ज्योतिषि Śi. 4. 67, Ratn. 3. 19. --3 (Fig.) To ruin, undo: न वेत्सि मुषितमात्मानं K. 164, Ratn. 4. 3. --4 To eclipse, cover, envelop, conceal; सैन्यरेणुमुषितार्कदीधितिः R. 11. 51. --5 To captivate, enrapture, ravish. --6 To surpass, excel; मुष्णञ् श्रियमशोकानां रक्तैः परिजनांबरैः . गीतैर्वरांगनानां च कोकिलभ्रमरध्वनिं Ks. 55. 113; Ratn. 1. 24; Bk. 9. 92; Me. 47. {vII.v} {c1c} P. (मोषति) To hurt, injure, kill. {vIII.v} {c4c} P. (मुष्यति) 1 To steal. --2 To break, destroy.

m: मुष्टिक—घ्न m. ‘slayer of Muṣṭika’, N. of Viṣṇu, Pañcar.
मुष्टि—करण and मुष्टि—कर्मन्, n. clenching the fist, ŚrS.
मुष्टिक—स्वस्तिक m. a partic. position of the hands in dancing, Cat.
मुष्टि—मान्द्य n. slight loosening of the bow-string, L. (cf. -देश).
मुष्टि—मेय mfn. to be measured or spanned with one hand (as a waist), Kathās.
मुष्टि—म्-पच See नीवार- and श्यामाक-म्˚.
मुष्टि—मुख mfn. having a fist-like face, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 168.

s: puM, (muzwiM Dayati pibati । Dew + “nAqImuzwyoSca .” 3 । 2 । 30 । iti KaS । “arurdbizadajantasya mum .” 6 । 3 । 67 । iti mum .) bAlakaH । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥
v: pu॰ muzwiM Dayati De--Kac mum ca । bAlake trikA॰ ।

m: मुष्टि—न्यास m. N. of wk.
मुष्टि—पात m. pummelling, boxing, W.
मुष्टि—प्रश्न-चिन्तन n. N. of wk.
मुष्टि—प्रहार m. = -घात, Suśr.
मुष्टि—स्थ m. or n. (?) a kind of game, Siṃhās.
मुष्टि—ता f. firmness of grasp, MW.
मुष्टि—वध m. devastation of the crops, Daś.
मुष्टि—वर्चस् n. the feces compacted into a ball, Suśr.
मुष्टि—विसर्ग m. the opening of the fist or closed hand, KātyŚr.
मुष्टि—योग m. the offering of handfuls i.e. small quantities, Pracaṇḍ.
मुष्टि—युद्ध n. a pugilistic encounter, MBh.
मुष्ट्य् in comp. for मुष्टि.
मुष्ट्य्—आयोजन n. seizing a bow with the hand, L.
मुष्ट्य्—अङ्गुल m. n. a partic. measure of length, AmṛtUp.
मुष्ट्य्—अष्टक n. eight handfuls, L.
